name: Hyatt on the Bund Shanghai
positioning: Two-tower Hyatt hotel a short walk from the Bund, with floor-to-ceiling views of the Bund, the Huangpu River and the Pudong skyline
best_for: Travelers who want river and skyline views within walking distance of the Bund
Guests who want a suite with a balcony over the Huangpu River

facts.text: The hotel can reach the Lujiazui business district through the Xinjian Road Tunnel within 10 minutes.
Guest rooms are split between the East and West towers.
Pearl Tower View rooms look out on the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Lujiazui skyscrapers.
The Bund Suites have an open balcony, a separate cloakroom and an automatic coffee machine.
The Presidential Suite has a rooftop terrace and a Jacuzzi.
Miao Spa includes hot tubs, cold plunge pools, steam, sauna and relaxation rooms.
The hotel has an indoor heated swimming pool on the Lower Lobby level.
The pool area also has a separate whirlpool bath.
Xindalu - China Kitchen's signature dishes include Peking Duck roasted in a wood-fired oven.
Charging stations for electric vehicles are available.

highlights.text: The Bund is within a five-minute walk of the hotel.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Pudong or the Bund.
VUE Bar occupies the top two levels of the hotel, with views of both sides of the Huangpu River.
The Diplomat Suite's large French windows give a 270-degree view of both sides of the Huangpu River.
The Presidential Suite is a duplex on the top floor.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.
Pudong International Airport is 45 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
